description.summary: Magic runs from your mind into that of a willing creature, allowing your consciousnesses to partially meld.
description.value: Magic runs from your mind into that of a willing creature, allowing your consciousnesses to partially meld. While casting this spell, you must keep both your hands on the target’s cheeks, and your foreheads touching. Once the spell is complete, you and the target become bonded. You can only have one Bonded at a time. As long as you and your Bonded are on the same plane of existence, you and your Bonded will always know each other’s direction; if you are within 1 mile of each other, you know each other’s exact location, and can sense each other’s emotions. You are each also aware of when the other takes damage. The bonded creature within 100 feet of the caster who bonded you also receives the following: Alertness feat The ability to go without food/water The ability to get a full night’s rest with only 2 hours of sleep The ability to remain conscious while in negative HPs. If bond of the protector is used on a creature who has bonded you, they each have the ability to use telepathy for up to 100 feet.
